evidence_requests.question: Screen the current partition for unsupported internal splits and weak pair boundaries.
Assess whether the current boundary between K2_C0001 and K2_C0002 is represented as a distinguishable separation in the multimodal patient geometry.
Does K2_C0001 show a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype or molecular program relative to the appropriate comparison population?
Does K2_C0002 show a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype or molecular program relative to the appropriate comparison population?

Assess the boundary structure of the current pair K2_C0001 and K2_C0002: does the union of these two sets form one coherent candidate unit or retain meaningful internal subdivision in the multimodal patient geometry?

actions.reason: K2_C0001 has an interpretable biological identity (coordinated OXPHOS/immune/proliferative up-programs with developmental signaling down), but identity alone does not establish independent membership. Evidence directly bearing on the boundary is unsupportive: the pair structural diagnostic shows within-set and between-set fused affinities are nearly identical (0.00932 vs 0.00902) with a boundary silhouette of ~0.0003, and the pair affinity-geometry report shows near-zero current-label silhouettes in every modality (CT 0.013, RNA 0.079, WSI 0.050, WXS 0.091) with between-label distances barely exceeding within-label distances. The current boundary is therefore not represented as a distinct separation in patient geometry. Merge is not a legal structural action in this workflow, so the weak boundary cannot be repaired by union, and no supported internal subdivision exists. With independence unsupported and no plausible structural revision, K2_C0001 is not retained.

K2_C0002 has an interpretable biological identity (reciprocal down-regulation of OXPHOS/immune/proliferative programs with relative elevation of developmental signaling), but this identity does not establish independent membership. The pair structural diagnostic shows the current boundary is not expressed in fused geometry (within-set 0.00932 vs between-set 0.00902; boundary silhouette ~0.0003), and the pair affinity-geometry report shows near-zero current-label silhouettes across all four modalities with only marginal within/between distance separation. The boundary between K2_C0002 and K2_C0001 is thus not represented as a distinct separation. Merge is prohibited in this workflow, so the weak boundary cannot be resolved by union, and no internal subdivision is supported. Independence remains unsupported and no structural revision is available, so K2_C0002 is not retained.
